title: Hackers Exploit SonicWall SSL-VPN Vulnerability to Bypass Multi-Factor Authentication in Active Attacks
content_md: SonicWall has disclosed an SSL-VPN authentication enforcement flaw that could let attackers bypass SAML authentication and associated multi-factor authentication controls. Tracked as CVE-2026-19868, the issue carries a CVSS score of 7.1. Advisory SNWLID-2026-0014, published November 6, 2026, states that SonicWall PSIRT investigated a report indicating potential exploitation.
